title: Habits
emptyText: Start with one small habit you can do every day. You can add more whenever you like.

delete.title: Delete {name}?
delete.description: This permanently removes the habit and all of its history. This cannot be undone.

dialog.description: Choose an emoji, a name, a color and a schedule.
dialog.name: Name
dialog.effectiveNote: Changes apply from {date}, so your history stays as it was.
dialog.wheneverHint: Nothing is expected of it: no streak, no rate. It only counts how many times you do it this year.

links.title: Links (optional)
links.label: Link {number}
links.hint: "Open links" on the habit opens them all at once. Your browser may ask you to allow pop-ups the first time.

circles.title: Share with circles
circles.text: Choose how much of this habit each circle sees. These changes apply at once, without saving.
circles.empty: You are not in a circle yet.
circles.levelFor: How much of this habit {name} sees

loadFailedText: Check your connection and try again.
